telugu.title: యాదయ్య గారి మరణం: తర్వాత ఏం చేయాలి (గల్ఫ్ సాథి కేసు GS-7K32RA)
telugu.opening: మీకు కలిగిన నష్టానికి చాలా బాధగా ఉంది. మీరు ఒంటరి కాదు. ఈ పనులన్నీ సాథి కేస్‌వర్కర్ మీతో కలిసి చేస్తారు.
steps: సాథి కేస్‌వర్కర్ UAE లోని భారత రాయబార కార్యాలయానికి వివరాలు పంపుతారు.

మృతదేహాన్ని ఇంటికి తీసుకురావాలా, అక్కడే అంత్యక్రియలు చేయాలా అనేది కుటుంబమే నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. రాయబార కార్యాలయం ఇచ్చే అనుమతి పత్రం (NOC) పై కుటుంబ సభ్యులు సంతకం చేయాలి. సంతకం చేసే ముందు సాథి కేస్‌వర్కర్ దాన్ని తెలుగులో చదివి వినిపిస్తారు.
ఖర్చులు యజమాని భరించాలి. భరించకపోతే, రాయబార కార్యాలయాన్ని ICWF నిధి నుంచి సహాయం అడుగుతాం.
ఈ పత్రాలు దాచుకోండి: మరణ ధ్రువీకరణ పత్రం, రద్దు చేసిన పాస్‌పోర్ట్, ఉద్యోగ పత్రాలు, బ్యాంక్ ఖాతా వివరాలు.
రావాల్సిన జీతం, ఇతర డబ్బుల కోసం రాయబార కార్యాలయం ద్వారా యజమానిని అడుగుతాం.
యజమాని, రాయబార కార్యాలయం ఖర్చు భరించకపోతే, ప్రవాసీ ప్రజావాణి ద్వారా ముఖ్యమంత్రి సహాయ నిధి నుంచి సహాయం అడుగుతాం.
మృతదేహాన్ని ఇంటికి తీసుకురావడానికి ఎవరూ మిమ్మల్ని డబ్బులు అడగకూడదు. ఎవరైనా అడిగితే కేస్‌వర్కర్‌కి చెప్పండి.
గల్ఫ్ దేశాల్లో మరణించిన కార్మికుల కుటుంబాలకు తెలంగాణ ప్రభుత్వం ఎక్స్‌గ్రేషియా ఇస్తుంది. మరణించిన 6 నెలల లోపు జిల్లా కలెక్టర్ కార్యాలయంలో దరఖాస్తు చేయాలి. సాథి కేస్‌వర్కర్ సహాయం చేస్తారు.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Gulf Saathi</title><meta name="description" content="Gulf Saathi: a Telugu voice line that checks agents, fees, visas, and calls workers on arrival day and every week.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="preload" as="style" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anek+Telugu:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Sans+Telugu:wght@400;700&display=swap" onload="this.onload=null;this.rel='stylesheet'"><noscript><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anek+Telugu:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Sans+Telugu:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"></noscript><link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Ccircle cx='16' cy='16' r='16' fill='%23a8501c'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<style>
:root{--ink:#1d1a16;--muted:#5c544a;--line:#e6dccd;--bg:#f8f3ea;--card:#fffdf9;--sand:#efe2cc;--accent:#a8501c;--accent-ink:#fff;
--deep:#1f2328;--alert:#b42318;--ok:#067647}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--ink:#f2ece3;--muted:#b8ad9e;--line:#3a332b;--bg:#16130f;
--card:#201b16;--sand:#2b241c;--accent:#e2834a;--accent-ink:#16130f;--deep:#0e1114;--alert:#f97066;--ok:#4cc38a}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:17px/1.6 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans Telugu","Nirmala UI",sans-serif}
a{color:var(--accent)} img{max-width:100%;display:block}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
[lang="te"],.te,.t{font-family:"Noto Sans Telugu","Nirmala UI",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.65}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
nav{display:flex;gap:4px 16px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
nav .links{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
nav b{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.01em} nav .sp{flex:1} nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;white-space:nowrap}
.hero{padding:40px 16px 32px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,52px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .te{font-size:clamp(20px,3.5vw,28px);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 16px}
.hero p{font-size:18px;max-width:640px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px}
.big{position:relative;min-height:min(86vh,720px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;color:#fff;background:#14110e;overflow:hidden}
.big>img{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:50%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:20% center}
.big:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,17,14,1) 0%,rgba(20,17,14,1) 50%,rgba(20,17,14,.55) 52%,rgba(20,17,14,0) 55%)}
.big .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:56px}
.big .txt{max-width:min(480px,40vw)}
.big h1{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,48px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 14px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.big .te{font-size:clamp(18px,2.2vw,24px);color:#f0b27f;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 14px}
.big p{font-size:18px;color:#e8e1d7;margin:0 0 22px}
.big .btn.ghost{color:#fff;border-color:#fff}
.badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;color:#f3ede4}
.cap{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 0}
.big .cap{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:16px;bottom:10px;color:#e8e1d7;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
@media (max-width:640px){.big{display:block;min-height:0;background:var(--deep)}
.big>img{position:static;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3}.big:before{display:none}
.big .cap{position:static;color:#b8ad9e;text-shadow:none;padding:6px 16px 0;text-align:right}
.big .wrap{padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:32px}.big .txt{max-width:none}.big h1{font-size:30px}}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;margin:0 8px 8px 0}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);border:2px solid var(--accent)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}
section{padding:48px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,32px);line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 10px;letter-spacing:-.01em} .lede{color:var(--muted);max-width:720px;margin:0 0 24px}
.nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}
.num{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--alert);border-radius:12px;padding:18px}
.num b{display:block;font-size:44px;line-height:1;color:var(--alert);margin-bottom:8px} .num p{margin:0 0 10px}
.src{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 6fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
.story img{border-radius:14px;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;object-fit:cover}
.vs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin:18px 0;align-items:stretch}
.vs div{border-radius:12px;padding:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.vs h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:17px} .vs ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px} .vs li{margin-bottom:6px}
.vs .without{border-top:4px solid var(--alert)} .vs .with{border-top:4px solid var(--ok)}
@media (max-width:820px){.story,.vs{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.timeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px;counter-reset:s;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.timeline li{position:relative;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:46px 14px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.timeline li .st{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start}
.timeline li:before{counter-increment:s;content:counter(s);position:absolute;top:12px;left:14px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;
background:var(--deep);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.timeline h3{margin:0;font-size:17px} .timeline .t{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:15px} .timeline p{margin:8px 0 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
@media (max-width:900px){.timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr;border-left:3px solid var(--line);margin-left:12px;padding-left:20px}
.timeline li{padding-top:14px}.timeline li:before{left:-35px;top:14px}}
.st{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 7px;white-space:nowrap}
.st.live{background:#d1fadf;color:#05603a} .st.testing{background:#fef0c7;color:#93370d}
.who{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}
.who article{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.who img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover} .who .in{padding:12px 16px 16px} .who h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px} .who p{margin:0}
.who .plain{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:var(--sand);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.who .plain svg{width:84px;height:84px} .who .mini{display:none;width:28px;height:28px;color:var(--accent)}
@media (max-width:640px){.who .plain{display:none}.who .mini{display:inline-block;vertical-align:-6px;margin-right:6px}}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px}
@media (max-width:760px){.tiles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.tiles .tile:nth-child(5){grid-column:1/-1}}
.tile{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px}
.tile b{display:block;font-size:30px;line-height:1.1} .tile span{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.shotbox{position:relative;max-height:320px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);margin:20px 0 8px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.shotbox:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:36px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0),#fff)}
.shotbox img{width:100%}
.tag{display:inline-block;background:#fef0c7;color:#93370d;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
.callbox{background:var(--deep);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:22px}
.callbox h2{color:#fff} .callbox p{color:#d6dde4}
.callbox label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin:10px 0 4px;font-size:14px}
.callbox input{width:100%;max-width:360px;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #4b5a68;background:#0f151b;color:#fff;font:inherit}
#msg{margin-top:12px;font-weight:700;min-height:1.6em}
#msg:empty{margin:0;min-height:0}
.honest{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)} .honest li{margin-bottom:4px}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:12px}
.step{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px}
.step>b:first-child{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
#started{padding:28px 0}
.callbox .tel{color:#fff;font-size:1.15em;white-space:nowrap}
#started h2{margin-bottom:16px}
#started .pics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.24fr 3.57fr;gap:14px;margin:0 0 20px}
#started figure{margin:0}
#started figcaption a{display:inline-block;padding:6px 0}
@media (max-width:700px){#started .pics{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
#started figure img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
#started figcaption{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
#started .area{margin:4px 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
#started .tl{list-style:none;margin:0 0 12px;padding:0 0 8px;display:flex;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
#started .tl li{position:relative;flex:0 0 76%;max-width:300px;scroll-snap-align:start;padding-top:40px}
#started .tl li:before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);color:#fff;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
#started .tl li.next:before{content:"";background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--accent)}
#started .tl li:not(:last-child):after{content:"";position:absolute;left:34px;right:-14px;top:13px;height:2px;background:var(--ok)}
#started .tl b{font-size:17px} #started .tl .t{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin:0}
#started .tl p{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5} #started .tl .te{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
#started .tag{display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;border-radius:999px;padding:0 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;
  background:var(--sand);color:var(--ok);vertical-align:middle}
#started li.next .tag{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
@media (min-width:900px){#started .tl{overflow:visible}#started .tl li{flex:1 1 0;max-width:none}}
.video{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto}
.video video{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#000;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.video p{text-align:center;margin:10px 0 0}
.label{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);border:1px dashed var(--muted);border-radius:6px;padding:2px 8px;margin:0 0 10px;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.5}
.hear{max-width:560px;margin:4px 0 14px} .hl{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:10px}
details.more{margin-top:22px}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .bubble{background:#2b2214;border-color:#7a5a20;color:#f2ece3}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .bubble .te{color:#f6e3bf} :root:not([data-theme="light"]) .bubble .en{color:#d9c7a3}

:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .shotbox{opacity:.92;border-color:#3a332b}}
#why{padding:28px 0}
.traction{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:16px}
.player{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;max-width:820px}
.player audio{width:100%;margin-bottom:10px}
.caps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.caps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr;gap:2px 12px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer}

.wedges{margin:0;padding-left:18px} .wedges li{margin-bottom:6px}

details.more>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details.more>summary:after{content:" ▾"} details.more[open]>summary:after{content:" ▴"}
details.more .arch{margin-top:14px}

.bubble svg{position:absolute;left:14px;top:14px;width:20px;height:20px;color:#a86a00}

.netbox{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin:0 0 22px}

.cn-in{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}

.cn-row span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:right;min-width:0}

.cn-row.bad{border-left-color:var(--alert)} .cn-row.bad span{color:var(--alert);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em}

<section id="how"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>How it works</h2>
  <p class="lede">One phone number, in Telugu, at every step of the journey. No app, no reading needed.</p>
  <ol class="timeline"><li><h3>Before paying</h3><div class="t">డబ్బు ఇచ్చే ముందు</div><p>Is the agent licensed? Checks 2,447 agents (MEA eMigrate, 8 Apr 2026). Adds up every payment against the ₹35,400 legal limit.</p></li><li><h3>Before flying</h3><div class="t">ప్రయాణానికి ముందు</div><p>Records the promised job, visa and payments. Flags a visit visa or a different job at once.</p></li><li><h3>Arrival day</h3><div class="t">చేరిన రోజు</div><p>Calls on landing: did the registered employer pick you up?</p></li><li><h3>Every week</h3><div class="t">ప్రతి వారం</div><p>Salary, passport, food, threats, same job and city? Two missed calls in a row raise an alert (one, for a woman in housework).</p></li><li><h3>When something is wrong</h3><div class="t">సమస్య వస్తే</div><p>Caseworker dashboard, English complaint-ready packet, and a Telugu SMS for the family, ready to send.</p></li></ol>
  <p class="honest" style="margin-top:18px">The AI only writes down what was said. Fixed rules decide the risk level.</p>

    <div class="vs">
      <div class="without"><h3>Without Saathi</h3><ul>
        <li>Pays the agent in cash, no record</li><li>A stranger picks him up</li>
        <li>The family learns from a video, too late</li></ul></div>
      <div class="with"><h3>With Saathi</h3><ul>
        <li>Wrong visa flagged before he flies</li><li>Arrival call: wrong pickup = CRITICAL</li>
        <li>"Herding goats" is not the promised job = HIGH</li></ul></div>
    </div>
    <p><a class="more-link" href="/demo">Run this story on the demo →</a> <span class="src">(no password)</span></p>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section id="repeat-agent"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>How Saathi catches a repeat scam agent</h2>
  <p class="lede">Sub-agents cheat family after family with the same phone number or UPI account. Each family complains
  alone. Saathi connects the reports and warns the next family before they pay.</p>
  <span class="label">Example. Made-up names and number.</span>
  <div class="netbox" id="case-network"><div class="cn">
  <ul class="cn-in"><li class="cn-row bad"><b>Worker 1 · Jagtial</b><span>CRITICAL</span></li><li class="cn-row bad"><b>Worker 2 · Nizamabad</b><span>HIGH</span></li><li class="cn-row "><b>Callers 3 & 4</b><span>₹1.5 lakh asked · visit visa offered</span></li></ul>
  <div class="cn-arrow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="cn-hub"><div class="k">Same number</div>
    <div class="id">Phone 98480 XXXXX</div><div class="id">UPI ****@ybl</div>
    <div class="cnt">2 cases · 2 reports</div></div>
  <div class="cn-arrow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="cn-out"><div class="k">Next caller</div><b>Caller 5 · warned before paying</b>
    <span class="pill">DID NOT PAY</span></div>
</div>
</div>
  <div class="hear"><div class="hl">What caller 5 hears (roughly)</div><div class="bubble"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 3h4l2 5-2.5 1.5a11 11 0 0 0 6 6L16 13l5 2v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2A16 16 0 0 1 3 5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2z"/></svg><p class="te" lang="te">ఈ నంబర్ మరో 2 సాథి కేసుల్లో వచ్చింది. ఇది రుజువు కాదు, కానీ కేస్‌వర్కర్ చూసే వరకు డబ్బు ఇవ్వకండి.</p><p class="en">"This number came up in 2 other Saathi cases. It's not proof, but don't pay until a caseworker checks."</p></div></div>
  <p class="honest" style="margin-top:10px">Callers hear only a count, never names. Proven on a real Bolna call; the
  multi-caller flow is tested in code.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="who"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Who it helps</h2>
  <div class="who">
    <article><img src="/gs_family_sms.webp" srcset="/gs_family_sms-600.webp 600w, /gs_family_sms.webp 1200w" sizes="(max-width:640px) 100vw, 340px" width="1200" height="896" alt="A mother at home reading a message on her phone" loading="lazy">
      <div class="in"><p class="cap" style="margin:0 0 8px">AI-generated illustration</p><h3>Family</h3>
      <p>A Telugu SMS is ready for the family the moment something is wrong.</p></div></article>
    <article><img src="/gs_caseworker.webp" srcset="/gs_caseworker-600.webp 600w, /gs_caseworker.webp 1200w" sizes="(max-width:640px) 100vw, 340px" width="1200" height="896" alt="A caseworker with a headset at a laptop" loading="lazy">
      <div class="in"><p class="cap" style="margin:0 0 8px">AI-generated illustration</p><h3>Volunteers and caseworkers</h3>
      <p>A ready case: who, where, which agent, what was promised.</p></div></article>
    <article><div class="plain"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5h17l9 9v13"/><path d="M29 5v9h9"/><path d="M12 5v38h16"/><path d="M18 20h12M18 27h8"/><path d="M38 31l-7 3v5c0 4 3 6.5 7 8 4-1.5 7-4 7-8v-5z"/><path d="M35 39.5l2.2 2.2 4-4.2"/></svg><span>Police · TOMCOM · State</span></div>
      <div class="in"><h3><span class="mini"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5h17l9 9v13"/><path d="M29 5v9h9"/><path d="M12 5v38h16"/><path d="M18 20h12M18 27h8"/><path d="M38 31l-7 3v5c0 4 3 6.5 7 8 4-1.5 7-4 7-8v-5z"/><path d="M35 39.5l2.2 2.2 4-4.2"/></svg></span>Government</h3>
      <p>An evidence trail for every case, built one call at a time.</p></div></article>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section id="heard"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>What we heard at Pravasi Prajavani</h2>
  <p class="src">On 30 October 2026 we sat in on Pravasi Prajavani, the Gulf workers' grievance desk at Praja Bhavan,
  Hyderabad.</p>
  <div class="vs heard">
    <div class="today"><h3>Today</h3><ul>
      <li>No simple Telugu phone line the worker knows to call</li>
      <li>Help starts only when the family finds out and travels to Hyderabad</li>
      <li>Officials spend weeks collecting the employer, visa, agent and route before the embassy can act</li>
      <li>Workers can't check what the agent tells them</li></ul>
      <p class="end">Often weeks to start a case</p></div>
    <div class="with"><h3>With Saathi</h3><ul>
      <li>The agent's promise is recorded in Telugu before the worker pays</li>
      <li>The route, visa, employer, fees and document details are recorded from day one</li>
      <li>Weekly check-in calls, and a Telugu help line (being opened)</li>
      <li>The desk gets a ready case file</li></ul>
      <p class="end">Case file ready from the first call</p></div>
  </div>
  <p class="hl" style="margin:16px 0 8px">Cases we heard about</p>
  <ul class="pills"><li>Route changed without telling the worker</li><li>Told to wait in a third country</li>
    <li>A recruit reportedly sent to Russia</li></ul>
  <p class="src" style="margin-top:14px">Officials also asked for regular scam warnings to workers and families. Saathi now
  sends weekly scam alerts to workers and families who agree: as a voice call or SMS.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="who-pays"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Who pays</h2>
  <p class="lede">Paid for by those who already spend money on Gulf-worker welfare.</p>
  <ol class="payers">
    <li><h3>Telangana government</h3><p>About 15 lakh Telangana people work in the Gulf. The state already pays ₹5 lakh
    ex-gratia per Gulf death (G.O. 205, 16 Sep 2024) and runs Pravasi Prajavani. Saathi gives its desk early warning and a ready case file,
    sorted by district.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Other states</h3><p>Andhra Pradesh's Konaseema district built a migration help desk. In March 2026 the Chief
    Minister reportedly directed that it be scaled statewide. Saathi is the Telugu phone line that desk doesn't have.
    Next: Kerala, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Gulf employers</h3><p>Companies that must prove fair recruitment can show every promise their workers heard
    was recorded.</p></li>
  </ol>
  <p class="never-line">Never paid by recruiting agents. Never sells worker data.</p>
  <p class="src">15 lakh: <a href="https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/telangana-families-worry-about-gulf-migrant-workers-amid-west-asia-tensions/article70692242.ece"
  target="_blank" rel="noopener">The Hindu, Mar 2026</a>. Konaseema:
  <a href="https://www.thehansindia.com/andhra-pradesh/naidu-praises-7-dist-collectors-1055738" target="_blank"
  rel="noopener">The Hans India, 12 Mar 2026</a>.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="numbers"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Caseworker view</h2>
  <div class="shotwrap"><div class="shotbox"><img src="/gs_dashboard.webp" width="1602" height="385" alt="The caseworker dashboard showing a made-up demo case marked CRITICAL, with its red flags" loading="lazy"></div>
  <p class="cap">Screenshot with a made-up demo case.</p></div>
  <p style="margin-top:14px"><a class="btn ghost" href="/demo">Open the demo (no password)</a> <a class="btn ghost" href="/login">Team login</a></p>
</div></section>

<section id="call"><div class="wrap"><div class="callbox">
  <h2>Call Saathi</h2><p>Call <a class="tel" href="tel:+918065952403"><b>+91 80659 52403</b></a> and speak in Telugu. Ask Saathi to check an agent's name or a fee, or tell it what is wrong.</p><p class="te" lang="te">తెలుగులో మాట్లాడండి.</p><hr style="border:0;border-top:1px solid #4b5a68;margin:18px 0">
  <h2>Get a call from Saathi</h2>
  <p>Saathi will call your phone in Telugu. Ask it to check an agent's name or a fee. Indian numbers only for now.</p>
  <form id="cf" onsubmit="return false">
  <label for="phone">Your phone number</label><input id="phone" name="phone" inputmode="tel" placeholder="98765 43210" required>
  <label for="code">Demo code (from the Gulf Saathi team)</label><input id="code" name="code" autocomplete="off" required>
  <p style="margin-top:14px"><button class="btn" id="go" type="submit">Get a call from Saathi</button></p>
  <div id="msg" aria-live="polite"></div></form>
<script>
document.getElementById('cf').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('go'), msg = document.getElementById('msg');
  btn.disabled = true; msg.textContent = 'Asking Saathi to call…';
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/demo-call', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.target).entries()))});
    const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(j.detail || r.status);
    msg.textContent = 'Saathi is calling you now. Say “తెలుగు” when it answers.';
  } catch (err) { msg.textContent = 'Could not start the call: ' + err.message; btn.disabled = false; }
});
</script>
</div></div></section>

<footer><div class="wrap">Built for the Bolna Buildathon 2026. Saathi records every Gulf job promise before the worker
pays, checks on them after they land, and turns trouble into a ready case file for the people who can act.</div></footer>
</body></html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Gulf Saathi</title><meta name="description" content="Gulf Saathi: a Telugu voice line that checks agents, fees, visas, and calls workers on arrival day and every week.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

<style>
:root{--ink:#1d1a16;--muted:#5c544a;--line:#e6dccd;--bg:#f8f3ea;--card:#fffdf9;--sand:#efe2cc;--accent:#a8501c;--accent-ink:#fff;
--deep:#1f2328;--alert:#b42318;--ok:#067647}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--ink:#f2ece3;--muted:#b8ad9e;--line:#3a332b;--bg:#16130f;
--card:#201b16;--sand:#2b241c;--accent:#e2834a;--accent-ink:#16130f;--deep:#0e1114;--alert:#f97066;--ok:#4cc38a}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:17px/1.6 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans Telugu","Nirmala UI",sans-serif}
a{color:var(--accent)} img{max-width:100%;display:block}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
[lang="te"],.te,.t{font-family:"Noto Sans Telugu","Nirmala UI",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.65}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
nav{display:flex;gap:4px 16px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
nav .links{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
nav b{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.01em} nav .sp{flex:1} nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;white-space:nowrap}
.hero{padding:40px 16px 32px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,52px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .te{font-size:clamp(20px,3.5vw,28px);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 16px}
.hero p{font-size:18px;max-width:640px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px}
.big{position:relative;min-height:min(86vh,720px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;color:#fff;background:#14110e;overflow:hidden}
.big>img{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:50%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:20% center}
.big:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,17,14,1) 0%,rgba(20,17,14,1) 50%,rgba(20,17,14,.55) 52%,rgba(20,17,14,0) 55%)}
.big .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:56px}
.big .txt{max-width:min(480px,40vw)}
.big h1{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,48px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 14px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.big .te{font-size:clamp(18px,2.2vw,24px);color:#f0b27f;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 14px}
.big p{font-size:18px;color:#e8e1d7;margin:0 0 22px}
.big .btn.ghost{color:#fff;border-color:#fff}
.badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;color:#f3ede4}
.cap{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 0}
.big .cap{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:16px;bottom:10px;color:#e8e1d7;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
@media (max-width:640px){.big{display:block;min-height:0;background:var(--deep)}
.big>img{position:static;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3}.big:before{display:none}
.big .cap{position:static;color:#b8ad9e;text-shadow:none;padding:6px 16px 0;text-align:right}
.big .wrap{padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:32px}.big .txt{max-width:none}.big h1{font-size:30px}}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;margin:0 8px 8px 0}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);border:2px solid var(--accent)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}
section{padding:48px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,32px);line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 10px;letter-spacing:-.01em} .lede{color:var(--muted);max-width:720px;margin:0 0 24px}
.nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}
.num{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--alert);border-radius:12px;padding:18px}
.num b{display:block;font-size:44px;line-height:1;color:var(--alert);margin-bottom:8px} .num p{margin:0 0 10px}
.src{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 6fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
.story img{border-radius:14px;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;object-fit:cover}
.vs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin:18px 0;align-items:stretch}
.vs div{border-radius:12px;padding:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.vs h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:17px} .vs ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px} .vs li{margin-bottom:6px}
.vs .without{border-top:4px solid var(--alert)} .vs .with{border-top:4px solid var(--ok)}
@media (max-width:820px){.story,.vs{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.timeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px;counter-reset:s;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.timeline li{position:relative;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:46px 14px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.timeline li .st{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start}
.timeline li:before{counter-increment:s;content:counter(s);position:absolute;top:12px;left:14px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;
background:var(--deep);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.timeline h3{margin:0;font-size:17px} .timeline .t{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:15px} .timeline p{margin:8px 0 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
@media (max-width:900px){.timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr;border-left:3px solid var(--line);margin-left:12px;padding-left:20px}
.timeline li{padding-top:14px}.timeline li:before{left:-35px;top:14px}}
.st{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 7px;white-space:nowrap}
.st.live{background:#d1fadf;color:#05603a} .st.testing{background:#fef0c7;color:#93370d}
.who{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}
.who article{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.who img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover} .who .in{padding:12px 16px 16px} .who h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px} .who p{margin:0}
.who .plain{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:var(--sand);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.who .plain svg{width:84px;height:84px} .who .mini{display:none;width:28px;height:28px;color:var(--accent)}
@media (max-width:640px){.who .plain{display:none}.who .mini{display:inline-block;vertical-align:-6px;margin-right:6px}}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px}
@media (max-width:760px){.tiles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.tiles .tile:nth-child(5){grid-column:1/-1}}
.tile{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px}
.tile b{display:block;font-size:30px;line-height:1.1} .tile span{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.shotbox{position:relative;max-height:320px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);margin:20px 0 8px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.shotbox:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:36px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0),#fff)}
.shotbox img{width:100%}
.tag{display:inline-block;background:#fef0c7;color:#93370d;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
.callbox{background:var(--deep);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:22px}
.callbox h2{color:#fff} .callbox p{color:#d6dde4}
.callbox label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin:10px 0 4px;font-size:14px}
.callbox input{width:100%;max-width:360px;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #4b5a68;background:#0f151b;color:#fff;font:inherit}
#msg{margin-top:12px;font-weight:700;min-height:1.6em}
#msg:empty{margin:0;min-height:0}
.honest{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)} .honest li{margin-bottom:4px}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:12px}
.step{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px}
.step>b:first-child{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
#started{padding:28px 0}
.callbox .tel{color:#fff;font-size:1.15em;white-space:nowrap}
#started h2{margin-bottom:16px}
#started .pics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.24fr 3.57fr;gap:14px;margin:0 0 20px}
#started figure{margin:0}
#started figcaption a{display:inline-block;padding:6px 0}
@media (max-width:700px){#started .pics{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
#started figure img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
#started figcaption{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
#started .area{margin:4px 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
#started .tl{list-style:none;margin:0 0 12px;padding:0 0 8px;display:flex;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
#started .tl li{position:relative;flex:0 0 76%;max-width:300px;scroll-snap-align:start;padding-top:40px}
#started .tl li:before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);color:#fff;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
#started .tl li.next:before{content:"";background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--accent)}
#started .tl li:not(:last-child):after{content:"";position:absolute;left:34px;right:-14px;top:13px;height:2px;background:var(--ok)}
#started .tl b{font-size:17px} #started .tl .t{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin:0}
#started .tl p{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5} #started .tl .te{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
#started .tag{display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;border-radius:999px;padding:0 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;
  background:var(--sand);color:var(--ok);vertical-align:middle}
#started li.next .tag{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}

<section id="how"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>How it works</h2>
  <p class="lede">One phone number, in Telugu, at every step of the journey. No app, no reading needed.</p>
  <ol class="timeline"><li><h3>Before paying</h3><div class="t">డబ్బు ఇచ్చే ముందు</div><p>Is the agent licensed? Checks 2,447 agents (MEA eMigrate, 8 Apr 2026). Adds up every payment against the ₹35,400 legal limit.</p></li><li><h3>Before flying</h3><div class="t">ప్రయాణానికి ముందు</div><p>Records the promised job, visa and payments. Flags a visit visa or a different job at once.</p></li><li><h3>Arrival day</h3><div class="t">చేరిన రోజు</div><p>Calls on landing: did the registered employer pick you up?</p></li><li><h3>Every week</h3><div class="t">ప్రతి వారం</div><p>Salary, passport, food, threats, same job and city? Two missed calls in a row raise an alert (one, for a woman in housework).</p></li><li><h3>When something is wrong</h3><div class="t">సమస్య వస్తే</div><p>Caseworker dashboard, English complaint-ready packet, and a Telugu SMS for the family, ready to send.</p></li></ol>
  <p class="honest" style="margin-top:18px">The AI only writes down what was said. Fixed rules decide the risk level.</p>

  <ol class="caps" id="caps"><li data-t="0.2"><b>Caller</b><span class="te" lang="te">అక్కడ పోయిన తర్వాత నా పాస్‌పోర్ట్ పోయింది.</span><span class="en">After I went there, my passport was gone.</span></li><li data-t="8.3"><b>Caller</b><span class="te" lang="te">ఇప్పుడు నేను ఇండియాకి రావాలంటే ఏం చేయాలి?</span><span class="en">What do I do to get back to India?</span></li><li data-t="12.2"><b>Saathi</b><span class="te" lang="te">సరే, నోట్ చేస్తున్నాను.</span><span class="en">OK, I'm noting it down.</span></li><li data-t="19.4"><b>Saathi</b><span class="te" lang="te">మీరు ఒంటరి కాదు. మీ కేసు అత్యవసరంగా నమోదు అయింది; సాథి బృందం మీరు చెప్పిన విషయాలతో భారత రాయబార కార్యాలయాన్ని అప్రమత్తం చేస్తోంది.</span><span class="en">You are not alone. Your case is registered as urgent; the Saathi team is alerting the Indian Embassy with what you told us.</span></li><li data-t="29.6"><b>Saathi</b><span class="te" lang="te">వీలైతే ఇతరులు ఉన్న చోట ఉండండి, ఫోన్‌ను దాచుకుని ఛార్జ్‌లో ఉంచండి.</span><span class="en">If you can, stay where other people are. Keep your phone hidden and charged.</span></li><li data-t="35.0"><b>Saathi</b><span class="te" lang="te">దగ్గర కనిపించే భవనం, షాప్, మసీదు లేదా రోడ్డు పేరు ఏమిటి? మీ కేసు నంబర్ జీ ఎస్, డబ్ల్యూ 9 హెచ్ డబ్ల్యూ ఎస్ వై.</span><span class="en">What building, shop, mosque or road can you see? Your case number is G S, W 9 H W S Y.</span></li></ol></div>
  <p class="src">Real Bolna call, 21 Oct 2026, 42 seconds; the caller is a team member.</p>
  <p class="src">Live system: <b>5</b> calls answered, <b>2</b> from 1 person outside the team.</p>
</div></section>
<script>
(() => {
  const a = document.getElementById('callaudio'), items = [...document.querySelectorAll('#caps li')];
  if (!a) return;
  a.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
    let cur = null;
    items.forEach(li => { if (a.currentTime >= +li.dataset.t) cur = li; });
    items.forEach(li => li.classList.toggle('on', li === cur));
  });
  items.forEach(li => li.addEventListener('click', () => { a.currentTime = +li.dataset.t; a.play(); }));
})();
</script>

<section id="story"><div class="wrap story">
  <figure style="margin:0"><img src="/gs_desert_goats.webp" srcset="/gs_desert_goats-640.webp 640w, /gs_desert_goats.webp 1376w" sizes="(max-width:820px) 100vw, 460px" width="1376" height="768" alt="A worker alone in the desert with goats, looking at his phone" loading="lazy">
  <figcaption class="cap">AI-generated illustration</figcaption></figure>
  <div>
    <h2>Inspired by Aadujeevitham</h2>
    <p>In the film, based on the real story of Najeeb Muhammad, a man is promised a Gulf job and ends up herding goats in the desert, alone.</p>
    <div class="vs">
      <div class="without"><h3>Without Saathi</h3><ul>
        <li>Pays the agent in cash, no record</li><li>A stranger picks him up</li>
        <li>The family learns from a video, too late</li></ul></div>
      <div class="with"><h3>With Saathi</h3><ul>
        <li>Wrong visa flagged before he flies</li><li>Arrival call: wrong pickup = CRITICAL</li>
        <li>"Herding goats" is not the promised job = HIGH</li></ul></div>
    </div>
    <p><a class="more-link" href="/demo">Run this story on the demo →</a> <span class="src">(no password)</span></p>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section id="repeat-agent"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>How Saathi catches a repeat scam agent</h2>
  <p class="lede">Sub-agents cheat family after family with the same phone number or UPI account. Each family complains
  alone. Saathi connects the reports and warns the next family before they pay.</p>
  <span class="label">Example. Made-up names and number.</span>
  <div class="netbox" id="case-network"><div class="cn">
  <ul class="cn-in"><li class="cn-row bad"><b>Worker 1 · Jagtial</b><span>CRITICAL</span></li><li class="cn-row bad"><b>Worker 2 · Nizamabad</b><span>HIGH</span></li><li class="cn-row "><b>Callers 3 & 4</b><span>₹1.5 lakh asked · visit visa offered</span></li></ul>
  <div class="cn-arrow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="cn-hub"><div class="k">Same number</div>
    <div class="id">Phone 98480 XXXXX</div><div class="id">UPI ****@ybl</div>
    <div class="cnt">2 cases · 2 reports</div></div>
  <div class="cn-arrow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="cn-out"><div class="k">Next caller</div><b>Caller 5 · warned before paying</b>
    <span class="pill">DID NOT PAY</span></div>
</div>
</div>
  <div class="hear"><div class="hl">What caller 5 hears (roughly)</div><div class="bubble"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 3h4l2 5-2.5 1.5a11 11 0 0 0 6 6L16 13l5 2v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2A16 16 0 0 1 3 5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2z"/></svg><p class="te" lang="te">ఈ నంబర్ మరో 2 సాథి కేసుల్లో వచ్చింది. ఇది రుజువు కాదు, కానీ కేస్‌వర్కర్ చూసే వరకు డబ్బు ఇవ్వకండి.</p><p class="en">"This number came up in 2 other Saathi cases. It's not proof, but don't pay until a caseworker checks."</p></div></div>
  <p class="honest" style="margin-top:10px">Callers hear only a count, never names. Proven on a real Bolna call; the
  multi-caller flow is tested in code.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="who"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Who it helps</h2>
  <div class="who">
    <article><img src="/gs_family_sms.webp" srcset="/gs_family_sms-600.webp 600w, /gs_family_sms.webp 1200w" sizes="(max-width:640px) 100vw, 340px" width="1200" height="896" alt="A mother at home reading a message on her phone" loading="lazy">
      <div class="in"><p class="cap" style="margin:0 0 8px">AI-generated illustration</p><h3>Family</h3>
      <p>A Telugu SMS is ready for the family the moment something is wrong.</p></div></article>
    <article><img src="/gs_caseworker.webp" srcset="/gs_caseworker-600.webp 600w, /gs_caseworker.webp 1200w" sizes="(max-width:640px) 100vw, 340px" width="1200" height="896" alt="A caseworker with a headset at a laptop" loading="lazy">
      <div class="in"><p class="cap" style="margin:0 0 8px">AI-generated illustration</p><h3>Volunteers and caseworkers</h3>
      <p>A ready case: who, where, which agent, what was promised.</p></div></article>
    <article><div class="plain"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5h17l9 9v13"/><path d="M29 5v9h9"/><path d="M12 5v38h16"/><path d="M18 20h12M18 27h8"/><path d="M38 31l-7 3v5c0 4 3 6.5 7 8 4-1.5 7-4 7-8v-5z"/><path d="M35 39.5l2.2 2.2 4-4.2"/></svg><span>Police · TOMCOM · State</span></div>
      <div class="in"><h3><span class="mini"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5h17l9 9v13"/><path d="M29 5v9h9"/><path d="M12 5v38h16"/><path d="M18 20h12M18 27h8"/><path d="M38 31l-7 3v5c0 4 3 6.5 7 8 4-1.5 7-4 7-8v-5z"/><path d="M35 39.5l2.2 2.2 4-4.2"/></svg></span>Government</h3>
      <p>An evidence trail for every case, built one call at a time.</p></div></article>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section id="heard"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>What we heard at Pravasi Prajavani</h2>
  <p class="src">On 30 October 2026 we sat in on Pravasi Prajavani, the Gulf workers' grievance desk at Praja Bhavan,
  Hyderabad.</p>
  <div class="vs heard">
    <div class="today"><h3>Today</h3><ul>
      <li>No simple Telugu phone line the worker knows to call</li>
      <li>Help starts only when the family finds out and travels to Hyderabad</li>
      <li>Officials spend weeks collecting the employer, visa, agent and route before the embassy can act</li>
      <li>Workers can't check what the agent tells them</li></ul>
      <p class="end">Often weeks to start a case</p></div>
    <div class="with"><h3>With Saathi</h3><ul>
      <li>The agent's promise is recorded in Telugu before the worker pays</li>
      <li>The route, visa, employer, fees and document details are recorded from day one</li>
      <li>Weekly check-in calls, and a Telugu help line (being opened)</li>
      <li>The desk gets a ready case file</li></ul>
      <p class="end">Case file ready from the first call</p></div>
  </div>
  <p class="hl" style="margin:16px 0 8px">Cases we heard about</p>
  <ul class="pills"><li>Route changed without telling the worker</li><li>Told to wait in a third country</li>
    <li>A recruit reportedly sent to Russia</li></ul>
  <p class="src" style="margin-top:14px">Officials also asked for regular scam warnings to workers and families. Saathi now
  sends weekly scam alerts to workers and families who agree: as a voice call or SMS.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="who-pays"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Who pays</h2>
  <p class="lede">Paid for by those who already spend money on Gulf-worker welfare.</p>
  <ol class="payers">
    <li><h3>Telangana government</h3><p>About 15 lakh Telangana people work in the Gulf. The state already pays ₹5 lakh
    ex-gratia per Gulf death (G.O. 205, 16 Sep 2024) and runs Pravasi Prajavani. Saathi gives its desk early warning and a ready case file,
    sorted by district.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Other states</h3><p>Andhra Pradesh's Konaseema district built a migration help desk. In March 2026 the Chief
    Minister reportedly directed that it be scaled statewide. Saathi is the Telugu phone line that desk doesn't have.
    Next: Kerala, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Gulf employers</h3><p>Companies that must prove fair recruitment can show every promise their workers heard
    was recorded.</p></li>
  </ol>
  <p class="never-line">Never paid by recruiting agents. Never sells worker data.</p>
  <p class="src">15 lakh: <a href="https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/telangana-families-worry-about-gulf-migrant-workers-amid-west-asia-tensions/article70692242.ece"
  target="_blank" rel="noopener">The Hindu, Mar 2026</a>. Konaseema:
  <a href="https://www.thehansindia.com/andhra-pradesh/naidu-praises-7-dist-collectors-1055738" target="_blank"
  rel="noopener">The Hans India, 12 Mar 2026</a>.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="numbers"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Caseworker view</h2>
  <div class="shotwrap"><div class="shotbox"><img src="/gs_dashboard.webp" width="1602" height="385" alt="The caseworker dashboard showing a made-up demo case marked CRITICAL, with its red flags" loading="lazy"></div>
  <p class="cap">Screenshot with a made-up demo case.</p></div>
  <p style="margin-top:14px"><a class="btn ghost" href="/demo">Open the demo (no password)</a> <a class="btn ghost" href="/login">Team login</a></p>
</div></section>

<section id="call"><div class="wrap"><div class="callbox">
  <h2>Call Saathi</h2><p>Call <a class="tel" href="tel:+918065952403"><b>+91 80659 52403</b></a> and speak in Telugu. Ask Saathi to check an agent's name or a fee, or tell it what is wrong.</p><p class="te" lang="te">తెలుగులో మాట్లాడండి.</p><hr style="border:0;border-top:1px solid #4b5a68;margin:18px 0">
  <h2>Get a call from Saathi</h2>
  <p>Saathi will call your phone in Telugu. Ask it to check an agent's name or a fee. Indian numbers only for now.</p>
  <p><b>Demo calls are switched off right now.</b> Ask the Gulf Saathi team to turn them on.</p>
</div></div></section>

<footer><div class="wrap">Built for the Bolna Buildathon 2026. Saathi records every Gulf job promise before the worker
pays, checks on them after they land, and turns trouble into a ready case file for the people who can act.</div></footer>
</body></html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Gulf Saathi</title><meta name="description" content="Gulf Saathi: a Telugu voice line that checks agents, fees, visas, and calls workers on arrival day and every week.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="preload" as="style" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anek+Telugu:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Sans+Telugu:wght@400;700&display=swap" onload="this.onload=null;this.rel='stylesheet'"><noscript><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anek+Telugu:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Sans+Telugu:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"></noscript><link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Ccircle cx='16' cy='16' r='16' fill='%23a8501c'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<style>
:root{--ink:#1d1a16;--muted:#5c544a;--line:#e6dccd;--bg:#f8f3ea;--card:#fffdf9;--sand:#efe2cc;--accent:#a8501c;--accent-ink:#fff;
--deep:#1f2328;--alert:#b42318;--ok:#067647}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--ink:#f2ece3;--muted:#b8ad9e;--line:#3a332b;--bg:#16130f;
--card:#201b16;--sand:#2b241c;--accent:#e2834a;--accent-ink:#16130f;--deep:#0e1114;--alert:#f97066;--ok:#4cc38a}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:17px/1.6 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans Telugu","Nirmala UI",sans-serif}
a{color:var(--accent)} img{max-width:100%;display:block}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
[lang="te"],.te,.t{font-family:"Noto Sans Telugu","Nirmala UI",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.65}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
nav{display:flex;gap:4px 16px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
nav .links{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
nav b{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.01em} nav .sp{flex:1} nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;white-space:nowrap}
.hero{padding:40px 16px 32px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,52px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .te{font-size:clamp(20px,3.5vw,28px);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 16px}
.hero p{font-size:18px;max-width:640px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px}
.big{position:relative;min-height:min(86vh,720px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;color:#fff;background:#14110e;overflow:hidden}
.big>img{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:50%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:20% center}
.big:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,17,14,1) 0%,rgba(20,17,14,1) 50%,rgba(20,17,14,.55) 52%,rgba(20,17,14,0) 55%)}
.big .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:56px}
.big .txt{max-width:min(480px,40vw)}
.big h1{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,48px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 14px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.big .te{font-size:clamp(18px,2.2vw,24px);color:#f0b27f;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 14px}
.big p{font-size:18px;color:#e8e1d7;margin:0 0 22px}
.big .btn.ghost{color:#fff;border-color:#fff}
.badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;color:#f3ede4}
.cap{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 0}
.big .cap{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:16px;bottom:10px;color:#e8e1d7;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
@media (max-width:640px){.big{display:block;min-height:0;background:var(--deep)}
.big>img{position:static;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3}.big:before{display:none}
.big .cap{position:static;color:#b8ad9e;text-shadow:none;padding:6px 16px 0;text-align:right}
.big .wrap{padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:32px}.big .txt{max-width:none}.big h1{font-size:30px}}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;margin:0 8px 8px 0}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);border:2px solid var(--accent)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}
section{padding:48px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,32px);line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 10px;letter-spacing:-.01em} .lede{color:var(--muted);max-width:720px;margin:0 0 24px}
.nums{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}
.num{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--alert);border-radius:12px;padding:18px}
.num b{display:block;font-size:44px;line-height:1;color:var(--alert);margin-bottom:8px} .num p{margin:0 0 10px}
.src{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 6fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
.story img{border-radius:14px;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;object-fit:cover}
.vs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin:18px 0;align-items:stretch}
.vs div{border-radius:12px;padding:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.vs h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:17px} .vs ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px} .vs li{margin-bottom:6px}
.vs .without{border-top:4px solid var(--alert)} .vs .with{border-top:4px solid var(--ok)}
@media (max-width:820px){.story,.vs{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.timeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px;counter-reset:s;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.timeline li{position:relative;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:46px 14px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.timeline li .st{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start}
.timeline li:before{counter-increment:s;content:counter(s);position:absolute;top:12px;left:14px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;
background:var(--deep);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.timeline h3{margin:0;font-size:17px} .timeline .t{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:15px} .timeline p{margin:8px 0 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
@media (max-width:900px){.timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr;border-left:3px solid var(--line);margin-left:12px;padding-left:20px}
.timeline li{padding-top:14px}.timeline li:before{left:-35px;top:14px}}
.st{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 7px;white-space:nowrap}
.st.live{background:#d1fadf;color:#05603a} .st.testing{background:#fef0c7;color:#93370d}
.who{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}
.who article{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.who img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover} .who .in{padding:12px 16px 16px} .who h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px} .who p{margin:0}
.who .plain{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:var(--sand);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.who .plain svg{width:84px;height:84px} .who .mini{display:none;width:28px;height:28px;color:var(--accent)}
@media (max-width:640px){.who .plain{display:none}.who .mini{display:inline-block;vertical-align:-6px;margin-right:6px}}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px}
@media (max-width:760px){.tiles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.tiles .tile:nth-child(5){grid-column:1/-1}}
.tile{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px}
.tile b{display:block;font-size:30px;line-height:1.1} .tile span{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.shotbox{position:relative;max-height:320px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);margin:20px 0 8px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.shotbox:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:36px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0),#fff)}

<section id="how"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>How it works</h2>
  <p class="lede">One phone number, in Telugu, at every step of the journey. No app, no reading needed.</p>
  <ol class="timeline"><li><h3>Before paying</h3><div class="t">డబ్బు ఇచ్చే ముందు</div><p>Is the agent licensed? Checks 2,447 agents (MEA eMigrate, 8 Apr 2026). Adds up every payment against the ₹35,400 legal limit.</p></li><li><h3>Before flying</h3><div class="t">ప్రయాణానికి ముందు</div><p>Records the promised job, visa and payments. Flags a visit visa or a different job at once.</p></li><li><h3>Arrival day</h3><div class="t">చేరిన రోజు</div><p>Calls on landing: did the registered employer pick you up?</p></li><li><h3>Every week</h3><div class="t">ప్రతి వారం</div><p>Salary, passport, food, threats, same job and city? Two missed calls in a row raise an alert (one, for a woman in housework).</p></li><li><h3>When something is wrong</h3><div class="t">సమస్య వస్తే</div><p>Caseworker dashboard, English complaint-ready packet, and a Telugu SMS for the family, ready to send.</p></li></ol>
  <p class="honest" style="margin-top:18px">The AI only writes down what was said. Fixed rules decide the risk level.</p>
  <details class="more"><summary>Show how it is built</summary><div class="arch" id="architecture">
  <h3>How it is built</h3>
  <ol class="stages"><li class="stage"><div class="sh">Call</div><div class="ab">Telugu call from worker or family</div><div class="ab">Bolna voice agent · Sarvam saaras:v3 speech-to-text</div></li><li class="stage"><div class="sh">Backend</div><div class="ab">FastAPI on Vercel</div><div class="ab">Supabase case store</div></li><li class="stage"><div class="sh">Fixed rules</div><div class="ab small">Licensed agent?</div><div class="ab small">Fee over ₹35,400?</div><div class="ab small">Visit visa for a job?</div><div class="ab small">Number seen in other cases?</div></li><li class="stage"><div class="sh">Risk level</div><div class="levels"><span class="lv ok">OK</span><span class="lv medium">MEDIUM</span><span class="lv high">HIGH</span><span class="lv critical">CRITICAL</span></div></li><li class="stage"><div class="sh">Outputs</div><div class="ab small">Telugu warning on the call</div><div class="ab small">Dashboard + English case packet</div><div class="ab small">Family SMS, ready to send</div></li><li class="stage human"><div class="sh">Then</div><div class="ab">A human caseworker decides and acts</div></li></ol>
  <div class="loop" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <p class="looplabel">↺ Arrival-day and weekly check-in calls (Saathi Check-in agent)</p>
</div></details>
</div></section>

<section id="watch"><div class="wrap video">
  <h2>Watch the demo</h2>
  <video controls playsinline preload="metadata" poster="/gulf-saathi-poster-960.jpg">
    <source src="/gulf-saathi-demo.mp4" type="video/mp4"
      onerror="document.getElementById('watch').hidden=true">
  </video>
  <p class="honest">Demo video · real Bolna calls</p>
</div></section>

<section id="started"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>How Gulf Saathi started</h2>
  <div class="pics">
  <figure><img src="/gs_prajavani.webp" srcset="/gs_prajavani-800.webp 800w, /gs_prajavani.webp 1600w" sizes="(max-width:700px) 100vw, 420px" alt="A family meeting the Pravasi Prajavani desk at Praja Bhavan, Hyderabad"
    width="1600" height="714" loading="lazy"><figcaption>Pravasi Prajavani, Praja Bhavan, Hyderabad.</figcaption></figure>
  <figure><a href="https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1bkhsPZopf/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="/gs_pitch_wide.webp" srcset="/gs_pitch_wide-800.webp 800w, /gs_pitch_wide.webp 1600w" sizes="(max-width:700px) 100vw, 660px"
    alt="Left: the founder of Gulf Saathi explaining it. Right: the Pravasi Prajavani desk."
    width="1600" height="448" loading="lazy"></a>
    <figcaption>Explaining Gulf Saathi at Pravasi Prajavani, from a public Facebook post, Nov 2026.
    <a href="https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1bkhsPZopf/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watch the post</a></figcaption></figure>
  </div>
  <ol class="tl" id="tl" aria-label="How it started, swipe sideways"><li class="done"><b>Listened</b><span class="tag">Done</span><p>Sat at Pravasi Prajavani, Praja Bhavan, Hyderabad, and heard real cases from Gulf workers' families: wrong jobs, unpaid wages, and months of waiting for papers.</p></li><li class="done"><b>Built</b><span class="tag">Done</span><p>Weekly Telugu check-in calls, agent and fee checks before departure, and ready case files for officials.</p></li><li class="done"><b>Demoed</b><span class="tag">Done</span><p>Showed it to the Pravasi Prajavani team, Nov 2026.</p></li><li class="next"><b>Next: pilot</b><span class="tag">Next</span><p>We were told we can start a pilot with Gulf worker families in Telangana, starting with Jagtial.</p></li></ol>
  <p class="area">Pilot area: Jagtial district, Telangana. For families of Gulf workers.</p>
  <p><a class="btn" href="https://wa.me/919999999999" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Join the pilot</a></p>
</div></section>

<section id="hear"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Hear a real call</h2>
  <p class="lede">A test call: a worker in Dubai says his passport is gone. Saathi notes it, registers the case as urgent and reads out
  the case number. Tap a line to jump to it.</p>
  <div class="player"><audio id="callaudio" controls preload="metadata">
    <source src="/gs_call_help_line.mp3" type="audio/mpeg" onerror="document.getElementById('hear').hidden=true"></audio>
  <ol class="caps" id="caps"><li data-t="0.2"><b>Caller</b><span class="te" lang="te">అక్కడ పోయిన తర్వాత నా పాస్‌పోర్ట్ పోయింది.</span><span class="en">After I went there, my passport was gone.</span></li><li data-t="8.3"><b>Caller</b><span class="te" lang="te">ఇప్పుడు నేను ఇండియాకి రావాలంటే ఏం చేయాలి?</span><span class="en">What do I do to get back to India?</span></li><li data-t="12.2"><b>Saathi</b><span class="te" lang="te">సరే, నోట్ చేస్తున్నాను.</span><span class="en">OK, I'm noting it down.</span></li><li data-t="19.4"><b>Saathi</b><span class="te" lang="te">మీరు ఒంటరి కాదు. మీ కేసు అత్యవసరంగా నమోదు అయింది; సాథి బృందం మీరు చెప్పిన విషయాలతో భారత రాయబార కార్యాలయాన్ని అప్రమత్తం చేస్తోంది.</span><span class="en">You are not alone. Your case is registered as urgent; the Saathi team is alerting the Indian Embassy with what you told us.</span></li><li data-t="29.6"><b>Saathi</b><span class="te" lang="te">వీలైతే ఇతరులు ఉన్న చోట ఉండండి, ఫోన్‌ను దాచుకుని ఛార్జ్‌లో ఉంచండి.</span><span class="en">If you can, stay where other people are. Keep your phone hidden and charged.</span></li><li data-t="35.0"><b>Saathi</b><span class="te" lang="te">దగ్గర కనిపించే భవనం, షాప్, మసీదు లేదా రోడ్డు పేరు ఏమిటి? మీ కేసు నంబర్ జీ ఎస్, డబ్ల్యూ 9 హెచ్ డబ్ల్యూ ఎస్ వై.</span><span class="en">What building, shop, mosque or road can you see? Your case number is G S, W 9 H W S Y.</span></li></ol></div>
  <p class="src">Real Bolna call, 21 Oct 2026, 42 seconds; the caller is a team member.</p>
  
</div></section>
<script>
(() => {
  const a = document.getElementById('callaudio'), items = [...document.querySelectorAll('#caps li')];
  if (!a) return;
  a.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
    let cur = null;
    items.forEach(li => { if (a.currentTime >= +li.dataset.t) cur = li; });
    items.forEach(li => li.classList.toggle('on', li === cur));
  });
  items.forEach(li => li.addEventListener('click', () => { a.currentTime = +li.dataset.t; a.play(); }));
})();
</script>

<section id="story"><div class="wrap story">
  <figure style="margin:0"><img src="/gs_desert_goats.webp" srcset="/gs_desert_goats-640.webp 640w, /gs_desert_goats.webp 1376w" sizes="(max-width:820px) 100vw, 460px" width="1376" height="768" alt="A worker alone in the desert with goats, looking at his phone" loading="lazy">
  <figcaption class="cap">AI-generated illustration</figcaption></figure>
  <div>
    <h2>Inspired by Aadujeevitham</h2>
    <p>In the film, based on the real story of Najeeb Muhammad, a man is promised a Gulf job and ends up herding goats in the desert, alone.</p>
    <div class="vs">
      <div class="without"><h3>Without Saathi</h3><ul>
        <li>Pays the agent in cash, no record</li><li>A stranger picks him up</li>
        <li>The family learns from a video, too late</li></ul></div>
      <div class="with"><h3>With Saathi</h3><ul>
        <li>Wrong visa flagged before he flies</li><li>Arrival call: wrong pickup = CRITICAL</li>
        <li>"Herding goats" is not the promised job = HIGH</li></ul></div>
    </div>
    <p><a class="more-link" href="/demo">Run this story on the demo →</a> <span class="src">(no password)</span></p>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section id="repeat-agent"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>How Saathi catches a repeat scam agent</h2>
  <p class="lede">Sub-agents cheat family after family with the same phone number or UPI account. Each family complains
  alone. Saathi connects the reports and warns the next family before they pay.</p>
  <span class="label">Example. Made-up names and number.</span>
  <div class="netbox" id="case-network"><div class="cn">
  <ul class="cn-in"><li class="cn-row bad"><b>Worker 1 · Jagtial</b><span>CRITICAL</span></li><li class="cn-row bad"><b>Worker 2 · Nizamabad</b><span>HIGH</span></li><li class="cn-row "><b>Callers 3 & 4</b><span>₹1.5 lakh asked · visit visa offered</span></li></ul>
  <div class="cn-arrow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="cn-hub"><div class="k">Same number</div>
    <div class="id">Phone 98480 XXXXX</div><div class="id">UPI ****@ybl</div>
    <div class="cnt">2 cases · 2 reports</div></div>
  <div class="cn-arrow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="cn-out"><div class="k">Next caller</div><b>Caller 5 · warned before paying</b>
    <span class="pill">DID NOT PAY</span></div>
</div>
</div>
  <div class="hear"><div class="hl">What caller 5 hears (roughly)</div><div class="bubble"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 3h4l2 5-2.5 1.5a11 11 0 0 0 6 6L16 13l5 2v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2A16 16 0 0 1 3 5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2z"/></svg><p class="te" lang="te">ఈ నంబర్ మరో 2 సాథి కేసుల్లో వచ్చింది. ఇది రుజువు కాదు, కానీ కేస్‌వర్కర్ చూసే వరకు డబ్బు ఇవ్వకండి.</p><p class="en">"This number came up in 2 other Saathi cases. It's not proof, but don't pay until a caseworker checks."</p></div></div>
  <p class="honest" style="margin-top:10px">Callers hear only a count, never names. Proven on a real Bolna call; the
  multi-caller flow is tested in code.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="who"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Who it helps</h2>
  <div class="who">
    <article><img src="/gs_family_sms.webp" srcset="/gs_family_sms-600.webp 600w, /gs_family_sms.webp 1200w" sizes="(max-width:640px) 100vw, 340px" width="1200" height="896" alt="A mother at home reading a message on her phone" loading="lazy">
      <div class="in"><p class="cap" style="margin:0 0 8px">AI-generated illustration</p><h3>Family</h3>
      <p>A Telugu SMS is ready for the family the moment something is wrong.</p></div></article>
    <article><img src="/gs_caseworker.webp" srcset="/gs_caseworker-600.webp 600w, /gs_caseworker.webp 1200w" sizes="(max-width:640px) 100vw, 340px" width="1200" height="896" alt="A caseworker with a headset at a laptop" loading="lazy">
      <div class="in"><p class="cap" style="margin:0 0 8px">AI-generated illustration</p><h3>Volunteers and caseworkers</h3>
      <p>A ready case: who, where, which agent, what was promised.</p></div></article>
    <article><div class="plain"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5h17l9 9v13"/><path d="M29 5v9h9"/><path d="M12 5v38h16"/><path d="M18 20h12M18 27h8"/><path d="M38 31l-7 3v5c0 4 3 6.5 7 8 4-1.5 7-4 7-8v-5z"/><path d="M35 39.5l2.2 2.2 4-4.2"/></svg><span>Police · TOMCOM · State</span></div>
      <div class="in"><h3><span class="mini"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5h17l9 9v13"/><path d="M29 5v9h9"/><path d="M12 5v38h16"/><path d="M18 20h12M18 27h8"/><path d="M38 31l-7 3v5c0 4 3 6.5 7 8 4-1.5 7-4 7-8v-5z"/><path d="M35 39.5l2.2 2.2 4-4.2"/></svg></span>Government</h3>
      <p>An evidence trail for every case, built one call at a time.</p></div></article>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section id="heard"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>What we heard at Pravasi Prajavani</h2>
  <p class="src">On 30 October 2026 we sat in on Pravasi Prajavani, the Gulf workers' grievance desk at Praja Bhavan,
  Hyderabad.</p>
  <div class="vs heard">
    <div class="today"><h3>Today</h3><ul>
      <li>No simple Telugu phone line the worker knows to call</li>
      <li>Help starts only when the family finds out and travels to Hyderabad</li>
      <li>Officials spend weeks collecting the employer, visa, agent and route before the embassy can act</li>
      <li>Workers can't check what the agent tells them</li></ul>
      <p class="end">Often weeks to start a case</p></div>
    <div class="with"><h3>With Saathi</h3><ul>
      <li>The agent's promise is recorded in Telugu before the worker pays</li>
      <li>The route, visa, employer, fees and document details are recorded from day one</li>
      <li>Weekly check-in calls, and a Telugu help line (being opened)</li>
      <li>The desk gets a ready case file</li></ul>
      <p class="end">Case file ready from the first call</p></div>
  </div>
  <p class="hl" style="margin:16px 0 8px">Cases we heard about</p>
  <ul class="pills"><li>Route changed without telling the worker</li><li>Told to wait in a third country</li>
    <li>A recruit reportedly sent to Russia</li></ul>
  <p class="src" style="margin-top:14px">Officials also asked for regular scam warnings to workers and families. Saathi now
  sends weekly scam alerts to workers and families who agree: as a voice call or SMS.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="who-pays"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Who pays</h2>
  <p class="lede">Paid for by those who already spend money on Gulf-worker welfare.</p>
  <ol class="payers">
    <li><h3>Telangana government</h3><p>About 15 lakh Telangana people work in the Gulf. The state already pays ₹5 lakh
    ex-gratia per Gulf death (G.O. 205, 16 Sep 2024) and runs Pravasi Prajavani. Saathi gives its desk early warning and a ready case file,
    sorted by district.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Other states</h3><p>Andhra Pradesh's Konaseema district built a migration help desk. In March 2026 the Chief
    Minister reportedly directed that it be scaled statewide. Saathi is the Telugu phone line that desk doesn't have.
    Next: Kerala, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar.</p></li>
    <li><h3>Gulf employers</h3><p>Companies that must prove fair recruitment can show every promise their workers heard
    was recorded.</p></li>
  </ol>
  <p class="never-line">Never paid by recruiting agents. Never sells worker data.</p>
  <p class="src">15 lakh: <a href="https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/telangana-families-worry-about-gulf-migrant-workers-amid-west-asia-tensions/article70692242.ece"
  target="_blank" rel="noopener">The Hindu, Mar 2026</a>. Konaseema:
  <a href="https://www.thehansindia.com/andhra-pradesh/naidu-praises-7-dist-collectors-1055738" target="_blank"
  rel="noopener">The Hans India, 12 Mar 2026</a>.</p>
</div></section>

<section id="numbers"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Caseworker view</h2>
  <div class="shotwrap"><div class="shotbox"><img src="/gs_dashboard.webp" width="1602" height="385" alt="The caseworker dashboard showing a made-up demo case marked CRITICAL, with its red flags" loading="lazy"></div>
  <p class="cap">Screenshot with a made-up demo case.</p></div>
  <p style="margin-top:14px"><a class="btn ghost" href="/demo">Open the demo (no password)</a> <a class="btn ghost" href="/login">Team login</a></p>
</div></section>

<section id="call"><div class="wrap"><div class="callbox">
  <h2>Call Saathi</h2><p>Call <a class="tel" href="tel:+918065952403"><b>+91 80659 52403</b></a> and speak in Telugu. Ask Saathi to check an agent's name or a fee, or tell it what is wrong.</p><p class="te" lang="te">తెలుగులో మాట్లాడండి.</p><hr style="border:0;border-top:1px solid #4b5a68;margin:18px 0">
  <h2>Get a call from Saathi</h2>
  <p>Saathi will call your phone in Telugu. Ask it to check an agent's name or a fee. Indian numbers only for now.</p>
  <form id="cf" onsubmit="return false">
  <label for="phone">Your phone number</label><input id="phone" name="phone" inputmode="tel" placeholder="98765 43210" required>
  <label for="code">Demo code (from the Gulf Saathi team)</label><input id="code" name="code" autocomplete="off" required>
  <p style="margin-top:14px"><button class="btn" id="go" type="submit">Get a call from Saathi</button></p>
  <div id="msg" aria-live="polite"></div></form>
<script>
document.getElementById('cf').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('go'), msg = document.getElementById('msg');
  btn.disabled = true; msg.textContent = 'Asking Saathi to call…';
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/demo-call', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.target).entries()))});
    const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(j.detail || r.status);
    msg.textContent = 'Saathi is calling you now. Say “తెలుగు” when it answers.';
  } catch (err) { msg.textContent = 'Could not start the call: ' + err.message; btn.disabled = false; }
});
</script>
</div></div></section>

<footer><div class="wrap">Built for the Bolna Buildathon 2026. Saathi records every Gulf job promise before the worker
pays, checks on them after they land, and turns trouble into a ready case file for the people who can act.</div></footer>
</body></html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

<link rel="preload" as="style" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anek+Telugu:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Sans+Telugu:wght@400;700&display=swap" onload="this.onload=null;this.rel='stylesheet'"><noscript><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anek+Telugu:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Sans+Telugu:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"></noscript><link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Ccircle cx='16' cy='16' r='16' fill='%23a8501c'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<style>
:root{--ink:#1d1a16;--muted:#5c544a;--line:#e6dccd;--bg:#f8f3ea;--card:#fffdf9;--sand:#efe2cc;--accent:#a8501c;--accent-ink:#fff;
--deep:#1f2328;--alert:#b42318;--ok:#067647}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--ink:#f2ece3;--muted:#b8ad9e;--line:#3a332b;--bg:#16130f;
--card:#201b16;--sand:#2b241c;--accent:#e2834a;--accent-ink:#16130f;--deep:#0e1114;--alert:#f97066;--ok:#4cc38a}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:17px/1.6 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans Telugu","Nirmala UI",sans-serif}
a{color:var(--accent)} img{max-width:100%;display:block}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
[lang="te"],.te,.t{font-family:"Noto Sans Telugu","Nirmala UI",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.65}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
nav{display:flex;gap:4px 16px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
nav .links{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
nav b{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.01em} nav .sp{flex:1} nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;white-space:nowrap}
.hero{padding:40px 16px 32px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,52px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero .te{font-size:clamp(20px,3.5vw,28px);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 16px}
.hero p{font-size:18px;max-width:640px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px}
.big{position:relative;min-height:min(86vh,720px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;color:#fff;background:#14110e;overflow:hidden}
.big>img{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:50%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:20% center}
.big:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,17,14,1) 0%,rgba(20,17,14,1) 50%,rgba(20,17,14,.55) 52%,rgba(20,17,14,0) 55%)}
.big .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:56px}
.big .txt{max-width:min(480px,40vw)}
.big h1{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,48px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 14px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.big .te{font-size:clamp(18px,2.2vw,24px);color:#f0b27f;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 14px}
.big p{font-size:18px;color:#e8e1d7;margin:0 0 22px}
.big .btn.ghost{color:#fff;border-color:#fff}
.badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;color:#f3ede4}
.cap{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 0}
.big .cap{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:16px;bottom:10px;color:#e8e1d7;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
@media (max-width:640px){.big{display:block;min-height:0;background:var(--deep)}
.big>img{position:static;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3}.big:before{display:none}

.person h3{margin:0;font-size:19px} .person .te{margin:0 0 2px} .person .who{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 12px;font-size:14px}
.person dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:4px 12px;margin:0 0 12px;font-size:14.5px}
.person dt{color:var(--muted)} .person dd{margin:0;font-weight:700}

.person .catch{font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#b42318;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 4px}
.person .btn{margin:auto 0 0;text-align:center}
.person .btn[aria-disabled=true]{opacity:.45;pointer-events:none}
.tl{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;counter-reset:s;max-width:760px}
.tl li{counter-increment:s;position:relative;padding:0 0 18px 48px}
.tl li:before{content:counter(s);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);
  color:var(--accent-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700}
.tl li:not(:last-child):after{content:"";position:absolute;left:15px;top:34px;bottom:2px;width:2px;background:var(--line)}
.tl b{display:block}
