.look li{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:14.5px}
@media (max-width:900px){.people{grid-template-columns:1fr}.look{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
<div class="wrap hero">
  <h1>The demo story</h1>
  <p class="te">యాదయ్య కథ</p>
  <p>Three made-up workers, from the first call to the case file. No password needed.</p>
  <p><span class="demo-note">Example. Made-up names and numbers. No real call or SMS is made.</span></p>
  <p style="margin-top:14px"><button class="btn" id="run">Run the story</button></p>
  <div id="msg" aria-live="polite"></div>
</div>
<section><div class="wrap">
  <h2>The three workers</h2>
  <div class="people"><article class="person">
  <h3>Yadaiah <span class="demo-note" style="font-size:11px;padding:1px 8px">DEMO</span></h3>
  <p class="te">యాదయ్య</p><p class="who">Going to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia</p>
  <dl><dt>Promised</dt><dd>Cleaner</dd><dt>Visa says</dt><dd>Agricultural worker</dd><dt>Paid</dt><dd>₹90,000 in two parts</dd></dl>
  <p class="catch">What Saathi catches</p>
  <ul><li>Agent not in the licensed list</li><li>Paid over the ₹35,400 limit</li><li>Visa job ≠ promised job</li><li>Arrival call: herding goats in Al Kharj, passport taken → CRITICAL</li></ul>
  <a class="btn ghost" id="open-yadaiah" href="#" aria-disabled="true">Run the story first</a>
</article><article class="person">
  <h3>Ramesh <span class="demo-note" style="font-size:11px;padding:1px 8px">DEMO</span></h3>
  <p class="te">రమేష్</p><p class="who">Going to Dammam, Saudi Arabia</p>
  <dl><dt>Promised</dt><dd>Driver</dd><dt>Visa</dt><dd>Visit visa</dd><dt>Paid</dt><dd>₹90,000 in two parts</dd></dl>
  <p class="catch">What Saathi catches</p>
  <ul><li>Visit visa for a job</li><li>Same village agent phone and UPI ID as Yadaiah: seen in 2 cases</li></ul>
  <a class="btn ghost" id="open-ramesh" href="#" aria-disabled="true">Run the story first</a>
</article><article class="person">
  <h3>Saraswathi, 27 <span class="demo-note" style="font-size:11px;padding:1px 8px">DEMO</span></h3>
  <p class="te">సరస్వతి</p><p class="who">Going to Muscat, Oman</p>
  <dl><dt>Promised</dt><dd>Housemaid</dd><dt>Visa</dt><dd>Tourist visa</dd><dt>Paid</dt><dd>₹80,000</dd></dl>
  <p class="catch">What Saathi catches</p>
  <ul><li>Tourist visa for housework</li><li>Paid over the ₹35,400 limit</li><li>Stopped before she flies</li></ul>
  <a class="btn ghost" id="open-saraswathi" href="#" aria-disabled="true">Run the story first</a>
</article></div>
</div></section>
<section><div class="wrap">
  <h2>What happens, step by step</h2>
  <ol class="tl"><li><b>Registered before flying</b>Yadaiah's promised job, visa and payments are recorded.</li><li><b>Red flags at once</b>Unlicensed agent, ₹90,000 paid, visa job is not the promised job: "do not pay more or travel until this is sorted out".</li><li><b>Family SMS</b>One Telugu SMS for his wife with the case number (shown, not sent).</li><li><b>Arrival-day call</b>A stranger picked him up. He is herding goats in Al Kharj and his passport was taken. Fixed rules mark it CRITICAL.</li><li><b>Case file</b>A Telugu alert for the family and an English case packet for MADAD or the embassy.</li><li><b>Seen in 2 cases</b>Ramesh paid the same village agent's phone and UPI ID. Shown as "needs human review", not as fraud.</li><li><b>A woman sent for housework</b>Saraswathi is going to Muscat as a housemaid on a tourist visa. Flagged before she flies.</li></ol>
</div></section>
<section><div class="wrap">
  <h2>What to look at on each case page</h2>
  <ul class="look"><li><b>Promise vs reality</b>: what was promised next to what the worker says now</li><li><b>Download English case packet</b>: the file a caseworker sends to MADAD or the embassy</li><li><b>Proof of work</b>: a dated record of every call, against a false absconding report</li><li><b>Seen in other cases</b>: the repeat-agent warning, on Yadaiah's and Ramesh's pages</li></ul>
</div></section>
<script>
document.getElementById('run').addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
  const msg = document.getElementById('msg'); e.target.disabled = true; msg.textContent = 'Creating the demo cases…';
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/demo/run', {method:'POST'});
    const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(j.detail || r.status);
    for (const k of ['yadaiah', 'ramesh', 'saraswathi']) {
      const a = document.getElementById('open-' + k);
      a.href = '/dashboard/case/' + j[k]; a.textContent = 'Open case ' + j[k]; a.className = 'btn';
      a.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
    }
    msg.textContent = 'Ready. Open any case below.';
    e.target.textContent = 'Story ready';
    document.querySelector('.people').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
  } catch (err) { msg.textContent = 'Failed: ' + err.message; e.target.disabled = false; }
});
</script>

<footer><div class="wrap">Built for the Bolna Buildathon 2026. Saathi records every Gulf job promise before the worker
pays, checks on them after they land, and turns trouble into a ready case file for the people who can act.</div></footer>
</body></html>
